mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential construction demand, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines consecutively, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recovery phases, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weak manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during early-cycle recovery when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day returns in early-cycle recovery is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which typically compresses discount rates and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) falls below 0.5% annualized, it signals a slowing economy that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth rate as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness typically leads to reduced consumer confidence and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day returns in high unemployment regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with weak manufacturing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * INDPRO) as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
